name: Article 1 – § 1 – after point 20; Regulation (EU) 2023/956 – Article 30 – after § 8 – 90
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2023/956 as regards the extension of its scope to downstream goods and anti-circumvention measures
part_text: (20a) in Article 30, the following paragraph is inserted: 'In the event of unforeseeable and exceptional circumstances causing significant harm to the Union’s internal market as a result of serious and unforeseen disturbances relating to the prices of goods covered by this Regulation, in particular where the inclusion of a good in Annex I contributes to such disturbances, the Commission, after taking into account all relevant evidence and carrying out an objective assessment, shall, where appropriate, take the necessary measures, including, in particular, by submitting legislative proposals, as required, to redirect CBAM revenues from those goods to the sectors affected by the serious disruptions to the internal market. Such a reallocation shall apply for a limited period, until the exceptional circumstances have ceased to exist.'
